description: 대전광역시 서구_소방서 현황 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대전광역시 서구. 해당 데이터는 화재·구조·구급 등 재난 대응 역량 분석, 소방력 재배치 검토, 지역 안전정책 수립, 지도 기반 시각화 등 다양한 공공 목적에 활용할 수 있도록 표준화된 구조로 구성되어. Coverage: 대전광역시 서구. The portal files it under the publisher 대전광역시 서구. Its tags are 소방서 주소, 119, 안전센터, 소방서, 재난안전. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
